claims.text: Non-complexified blocks of structure space have rho_exp = 0; complexification of V_{1/2} is necessary for rho_exp > 0 (Gap C resolution via thermodynamic selection).
Every self-modeling composite with rho > 0 satisfies S(t) < S_max (entropy gradient theorem), proved via three independent routes using different assumption subsets.
Each self-modeling update cycle dissipates work W >= k_B T I(B;M) (Landauer bound on self-modeling).
The single algebraic choice u in S^6 determines gauge group, chirality, AND the requirement for spacetime time-orientation (three-consequence theorem, extending Paper 7's two consequences to three).
Chirality of the Standard Model and the thermodynamic arrow of time share a common geometric prerequisite: time-orientation of the emergent spacetime (chirality-thermodynamics nexus).
The Past Hypothesis is elevated from 'observed feature' to 'necessary condition for self-modeling' (not derived, but given observer-selection status).

The Landauer entropy deficit (~10^28 nats) is 94 orders of magnitude below Penrose's gravitational estimate (~10^122 nats), reflecting different physical mechanisms; this gap is a feature, not a failure.
The selection chain from non-complexified V_{1/2} to rho = 0 runs: no chirality -> no time-oriented chiral matter -> no entropy gradient -> no free energy -> no self-modeling -> rho = 0.
The SWAP channel with maximally mixed model is a unital depolarizing channel; unitality is proved, not assumed.
Three independent arguments close the coherence loophole: Luders destroys coherence, maintaining coherence costs free energy, Sagawa-Ueda cross-check.
The paper completes the nine-link chain from self-modeling to the chiral Standard Model: 6 proved algebraically, 1 assumed (Gap B1), 1 updated (L7), 1 resolved via selection (L6, this paper).
The paper answers 'why complex numbers in QM?' within the self-modeling framework: because self-modelers require an arrow of time.
